# Mineralys Therapeutics Expands its Board of Directors with the Appointments of Kristine Peterson and Lonnel Coats


October 19, 2026 4:05 pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_4193d898ee19bcb79bbe1ebad0633f8b/mineralystx/news/2026-10-19_Mineralys_Therapeutics_Expands_its_Board_of_122.pdf)


### The addition of Ms. Peterson and Mr. Coats brings additional commercial and product launch experience to Mineralys ahead of the December 22 PDUFA target action date for lorundrostat


RADNOR, Pa., Oct. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: MLYS), a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and aldosterone-related adverse outcomes in comorbid conditions such as chronic kidney disease, obstructive sleep apnea and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone, today announced that Kristine Peterson and Lonnel Coats have been appointed to the Company’s Board of Directors.


“We are delighted to welcome Kris and Lonnel to our Board of Directors as we prepare for the potential approval and commercial launch of lorundrostat for the treatment of uncontrolled or resistant hypertension,” stated Jon Congleton, Chief Executive Officer of Mineralys. “As seasoned leaders who have each built and led commercial organizations, Kris and Lonnel bring deep experience launching and commercializing new therapies across multiple therapeutic areas, including cardiovascular and metabolic disease. We believe their track records of commercial execution, operational leadership and public company board service will make them valuable directors and resources as Mineralys transitions to a commercial-stage organization.”


“I am honored to join the Mineralys Board of Directors at such a pivotal time for the Company,” stated Ms. Peterson. “Having spent much of my career launching new medicines, including in cardiovascular disease, I appreciate the significant unmet need among patients whose hypertension is not controlled with currently available therapies. I look forward to working with the Company’s executive team and fellow Board members as Mineralys prepares for the potential commercial launch of lorundrostat.”


“I am pleased to join the Mineralys Board of Directors,” stated Mr. Coats. “Hypertension remains a leading driver of cardiovascular risk, and too many patients are unable to reach their blood pressure goals with currently available treatments. Lorundrostat has significant potential to offer a targeted treatment approach for hypertension driven by dysregulated aldosterone, and I look forward to contributing as the Company advances toward this next chapter.”


Ms. Peterson is a biopharmaceutical executive with more than three decades of experience in commercial, operational and general management leadership, including launching numerous products across multiple therapeutic areas. She most recently served as Chief Executive Officer of Valeritas, Inc., a commercial-stage medical technology company. Prior to Valeritas, Ms. Peterson served as Company Group Chair of the Biotechnology Group and Executive Vice President of Pharmaceutical Group Strategic Marketing at Johnson & Johnson, where she led commercial, research and development, and biologics manufacturing in oncology, immunology and cell therapy. Prior to Johnson & Johnson, Ms. Peterson served as Senior Vice President, Commercial Operations, of Biovail Corporation and President of Biovail Pharmaceuticals. Earlier in her career, Ms. Peterson spent 20 years at Bristol-Myers Squibb Company in a variety of senior roles in sales, marketing and general management, including leading its cardiovascular and metabolic disease business unit.


Ms. Peterson currently serves as a member of the Board of Directors at ArriVent BioPharma, Inc., Enanta Pharmaceuticals, Inc. and Immunocore Holdings plc. Ms. Peterson also previously served as a member of the board of directors of the Biotechnology Innovation Organization (BIO). Ms. Peterson received her B.S. in Marketing and her M.B.A. from the University of Illinois.


Mr. Coats is a biopharmaceutical executive with more than three decades of experience in building and leading commercial pharmaceutical organizations. He most recently served as Chief Executive Officer of Lexicon Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Prior to joining Lexicon, Mr. Coats served in a series of leadership positions, including Chief Executive Officer of North America, at Eisai Inc. and Eisai Corporation of North America, where he oversaw the commercialization of Eisai products in the therapeutic areas of oncology, neurology, gastrointestinal disorders, epilepsy and metabolic disorders. Prior to Eisai, Mr. Coats spent eight years with Janssen Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a division of Johnson & Johnson, where he held a variety of management and sales positions.


Mr. Coats currently serves as a member of the Board of Directors of Relay Therapeutics, Inc. Mr. Coats received his B.S. in Public Administration from Oakland University.


**About Mineralys**


Mineralys Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease, obstructive sleep apnea and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is an investigational, proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is based in Radnor, Pennsylvania, and was founded by Catalys Pacific.
